longitude_rule: Keep both native columns bracketing 80.5 E separately. Do not interpolate a fictitious observed section or pool their widths into uncertainty.
climatology_operator: Equal-weight mean of available paired year-month vector means, independently per native cell; both components use the same years.
source_locator: Huang et al. (2023), sections 2.1 and 3.1; Figures 1-3. 1995-2016, 1/3 degree OSCAR; SECC frequency/phase context 2.5-6 S, not paired velocity edges.
scope_note: Local near-surface eastward-component spans in the Indian SECC study region. Independent peaks may include other modes or eddies. Frequency-domain limits constrain peak search only; crossings may lie outside that window. No tracked current identity, flow-normal width, whole-current dimension or seasonal footprint admitted.
archive_boundary_rule: Retain returned original timestamps. Exclude any nearest-time boundary sample outside analysis years from calculation, record exclusions, and never replace or invent samples.
time_gap_rule: Report any archive gap outside 5-6 days. Preserve deficient monthly cells as missing; do not interpolate missing velocity or time.
